multiplexing and packet switching can be effective means of improving the utilization of the network bandwidth, but that the benefits depend on the traffic parameters of the various streams, and that the performance can be improved further by implementing a congestion control mechanism that is based on the leakiest bucket algorithm.

the performance of the network can be improved by using a large number of small virtual circuits instead of a smaller number of large virtual circuits, and that the performance of an ATM network can be improved if the traffic streams are shaped to have a small peak rate and a long mean burst length.

the performance of a broadband network is affected by the multiplexing, the switching and the call acceptance and bandwidth allocation policies, and that the queuing behavior depends on the three parameters commonly used in characterizing traffic.
